cause: The generated program called orders/place with subtotal 40 and explicitly failed because the returned total was not 110. The read orders source shows total is pricing.base/amount plus pricing.tax/amount; the terminal dependency sources return 80 and 20 respectively, so the total is 100, causing the order-total-mismatch failure.
evidence: execution_errors reported kind workflow_failed, reason explicit_failure, for evaluation mission-evaluation-1.
The generated source was (let [quote (orders/place 40)] (if (= (get quote "total") 110) quote (fail {:kind "order-total-mismatch"}))).
The orders prelude source defines place as {"total" (+ (pricing.base/amount subtotal) (pricing.tax/amount subtotal))}.
The pricing.base source returns 80 from amount, and the pricing.tax source returns 20 from amount; both sources had no further complete dependency relationships.
